text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC12345 - p99 latency spike for service= inference-eu, route=generate. Condition: p99_latency > 500ms for 5m. Auto-page to #eng-oncall. https://pagerduty.example/INC12345
sam_oncall: Acked. Oncall taking. Checking dashboards.
tara_ops: heads-up — I have a quick meeting in 7m, can cover handoff if needed.
sam_oncall: TL;DR: p99 ~700ms, p95 ~220ms. Surface customer impact: interactive APIs in EU might see timeouts in heavy tails. Initial logs point to sidecar kvcache evictions and slow disk IO.
leo_infra: I can see repeated KV eviction spikes and increased GC on sidecars in eu-west1. Pod mem usage at 92%. No node OOMs yet.
sam_oncall: Doing a quick mitigation: scale sidecar deployment + reduce inference batch size. Applying safe commands now.
sam_oncall: Runbook commands:```sh
kubectl scale deployment sidecar-eu --replicas=6 -n inference
kubectl set env deployment/inference-service-eu BATCH_SIZE=8 -n inference
```
tara_ops: :thumbsup: scaling started, pods coming up (3/3 ready on new replicas).
eng-sre-bot: Autoscaler event: +3 nodes provisioned in eu-west1 (autoscaler-group-3).
sam_oncall: p99 trending down — 480ms after scale. Still above SLO. Continuing mitigation.
leo_infra: Suggest partial traffic shift to dedicated-gold pool to relieve hot tails while we investigate root cause. Proposing a 15% shift.
sam_oncall: Initiating gradual routing change: 15% -> dedicated-gold. Monitoring metrics.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC12345 escalated to L2 (n+1) due to auto-escalation rule after 6m unacknowledged by L2. Notifying on-call L2.
tara_ops: Drafting a short customer-facing update: one sentence status + mitigation (scaling + routing), ETA for follow-up 30m. Will paste in thread for review.
sam_oncall: Update: p99 ~380ms and falling after 12m. CPU and mem utilization normalizing. Still watching for KV eviction recurrence.
leo_infra: Collecting core logs and sidecar metrics. I'll capture heap dumps if we see another eviction burst.
tara_ops: Customer note drafted and posted to status page.
sam_oncall: Leaving note in runbook and will open an incident ticket for RCA if we see recurrence. If p99 stabilizes <350ms for 10m, we'll close the page.
incident-bot: Last automated update: p99=340ms at 1866554440. Auto-page closed (manual ack remained).
